exit: 0
--- stdout
Validate a sequence and print the findings as a JSON report.

Stage 1 judges the model against the catalog; stage 2 (only when stage 1 is clean) loads the emitted CXF in a throwaway engine. Text input carries spans.

Usage: oce validate [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>
          The input file (`.oce` text, `.json` wire), or `-` for stdin

Options:
      --from <FROM>
          The input form; overrides the extension, and is required for stdin
          
          [possible values: text, wire]

      --render <RENDER>
          When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, always, never]

      --author-side
          Run stage 1 only (no engine load)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
--- stderr
